Gift of $69,000 is from an "interested party" (donor_relationship: "interested party"). Per B3-4.3-04, a personal gift donor may not be an interested party to the transaction. Per B3-4.1-02, interested party contributions (IPCs) cannot be used for down payment, reserves, or minimum borrower contribution. This gift is therefore impermissible and cannot be counted. Without it, the borrower has only $151,654 in bank balance, leaving $1,936 after closing — insufficient for the 2-month reserve requirement (B3-4.1-01). A condition cannot cure this by requesting a different donor or additional funds.

DECISION: decline  
RULES: B3-4.3-04, B3-4.1-02, B3-4.1-01
